title: Dev Engineer Frontend
full_description:
The Dev Engineer (Frontend) is accountable for development and maintenance of the new web application and app, using the latest technologies. In this role, following functional and technical analysis, you ensure the implementations that comply with the standards relating to perfomance, security and code maintainability, with respect of time and budget during all phases. Join us for this exciting opportunity!
Application development according to ING Bank standards
Work with project teams to ensure adherence with the solution design according to Designer, Business analyst, Architect, Release & Configuration Team and the Application manager
Develop source code and perform Unit Test
Work with Release and Configuration teams in order to manage code sourcing in the right way, merge code and resolve code conflicts in time
Follow bug-fixing during test phase (SIT and UAT)
Follow Production issue resolution in production environment
Delivery defect analysis in order to measure and recognize the goodness of solution design
Check and give feedback on functional and technical analysis
Manage communication and escalation processes when required
Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
3+ years’ experience in the same role in a 24/7 environment preferably within banking sector
Proven skills in the Agile way of working
Proven experience in application development with HTML5, CSS3, Javascript
Proven experience in application development with Angular / React
Knowledge of Javascript unit / component test frameworks
Good knowledge of issue and code versioning tools (Jira, Bitbucket, Azure, Git)
Excellent knowledge of digital channels
Good knowledge of IT Technologies
Good Italian and English level (written and spoken)
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office
Experience in application development with REST architecture
Knowledge on web components development
Knowledge of Java programming language
Knowledge of Spring Framework and its several modules (core, boot, web, mvc, data, security and more)
Knowledge of DBMS and SQL (Oracle, PL/SQL)
Passion for technology
Excellence in execution
Effective communication
Able to work under pressure
Work location: Milan (hybrid)
ING offers many opportunities to build a diverse and rewarding career. You will be joining an international innovative digital bank, the first in Italy to adopt a fully flexible smart working model, and you will be working in a stimulating environment where you can grow both as an individual and as a professional.
Our purpose - empowering people to stay a step ahead in life and in business - represents our belief in people’s potential. We don’t judge, coach or to tell people how to live their lives. We empower people and businesses to realize their own vision for a better future.
#doyourthing is our brand direction with us each and every day. It is how we articulate our purpose and our promise to make banking frictionless to the world. ‘do your thing’ is about people being free to live the life they want to live, knowing that they will make their world a little better for it.
Do you think you are "a step ahead"? Apply now!
The benefits of joining ING
In addition to being a part of a great team, working in a fun and innovative environment, we offer:
Super flexible smart working
Competitive base salaries and performance based bonuses
Diverse cultures & Innovative mindsets
International Environment
Commitment to sustainability
Lots of training development opportunities to help you grow
Lots of moments dedicated to physical and mental well-being
A special day off when it is your birthday: we call it #doyourbirthday!
And of course we can’t forget: free water & coffee at the office!
Diversity is a fundamental element of our corporate culture, and we are fully committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment, based on mutual respect and the value of diversity, offering equal job opportunities to all qualified candidates.
